candidates.prompt: Edit the supplied Liao-Jin courtyard map sprite. Keep the architecture, northern buff earth plaster, gray tiles, restrained realistic Song-kit rendering, upper-left lighting and true transparent cutout. Correct only its ground plan and camera: make the front facade and front enclosing wall about 16 percent LONGER along their existing axis while keeping the side depth unchanged. The result is a rectangular 10 by 8 metre courtyard, front edge 1.25 times side edge, visibly wider than the input. Use strict orthographic 2:1 dimetric projection: both ground axes make 26.565 degrees to horizontal (slopes +0.5 and -0.5), vertical walls stay vertical. The three visible thin footing corners must be clearly readable. Keep the far house broad and low and the left wing short. No thick display pedestal. No changes to period style, no new decoration. Complete building and footprint with generous transparent margin; no text, people, watermark or backdrop. ONE production map sprite on transparent RGBA, not a diagram.

candidates.prompt: Image 1 is an EXACT ground-plane construction template; image 2 is the appearance reference. Render one Liao-Jin courtyard in the exact ground footprint of image 1, with its front thin footing tracing the template's two lower edges exactly. Put the low buff plaster courtyard wall on those edges, the main gray-tiled wooden house along the back-right edge and the short wing along the back-left edge. Do not change the four template corner positions or its projection. The visible FRONT edge at lower left is 10 units long; the SIDE edge at lower right is 8 units long. All horizontal edges parallel to these template axes, no vanishing point. Remove the template black line and white background in the result; replace with complete detailed realistic ancient architecture, as image 2. Earth court and narrow stone wall base flush with the ground, no thick plinth. Main light upper left. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with fully clear alpha around the object. NO glow, NO halo, NO background color, NO ambient fog, only very short contact shadow under the lower-right footing. Keep muted gray clay tiles, sandy plaster, old wood, plain small gate in front wall. No people, text, symbols, lanterns or modern details. Fully framed complete map sprite. The ground perimeter geometry in image 1 is mandatory, the appearance in image 2 is the style reference only.
